assign.outcome:
**The magazine landed in the generator, and every generated page grew a `code` tab.** `specs.js`'s ninth shape is `/imagine/mag/` in three existing words (`wall full` / `list large` / six `prose`) — no sixth word needed. `route("code")` gives every generated page a real, undeclared `.../code/` url (never a directory, never in the exported tree) showing its own spec fragment, the `page.js` `export.js` would write for it right now, and a live transcript of `this.previews().style(...)` / `width: "..."` lines appended one per control click — `export.js`'s `module()` was split into `shape_for()`/`content_line()`/`width_line()` so the tab reads the same functions Export calls rather than reprinting them. [`public/imagine/paging/explorer/page.js`](/imagine/paging/explorer/) explains both and links to the generator with the magazine spec preselected.

**Seed-diff proof (the hard requirement): six diffs, all empty.** Seeds 7/42/1234 exported (`gen.js`+`tree.js`+`export.js`'s `files()`, run live in-browser) before every edit and after all of them — byte-identical spec text and file output, `diff` confirms empty on all six comparisons.

**ui-test:** clicked cols=2 then gap=airy on the magazine's wall root, opened its code tab → both `.style(...)` lines present (verified via `gen.calls`), the exported page.js for that page parses clean (`node --check`). Screenshots at 1280 and 3440, zero console errors throughout.

**A real trap found and fixed:** a link INTO the generator with `#s=<spec>` from outside was silently ignored on an in-app click — `Router.go()` pushState()s only after the target module already read the OLD `location.hash` in `land()`. Fixed with `target="_blank"` (`Router.js`'s own `link_clicked()` already excludes it), verified the popup lands on the exact spec. Documented in `doc/decisions.md` since it will bite the next link into this module.
